rule: **Rust constructors type their binding**: `let x = T { .. }` and `let x = T::new(..)` / `T::default()` / `T::with_capacity(..)` give `x` type T; an in-scan associated function gives its declared return type (`-> Self`/`-> T`). | Generic/template type arguments are dropped from every ID (`HashSet#<init>`).
source: KNOWN_GAP: receivers bound by match/if-let patterns, turbofish calls and user Deref impls are under-typed (turbofish part)
notes: Layout: src/ (the scan root) holds a Cargo package, Cargo.toml plus src/*.rs, so module paths are crate-relative. Stack::<u8>::new() is T::new(..) with a turbofish; the generic argument is dropped, so the binding s has type Stack → Stack#push high (and Stack::new is in scan, -> Self). Vec::<u8>::with_capacity(4) types v as Vec → Vec#push medium. s.push / v.push low guesses are wrong. Field items: Vec<T> → Vec#push. call_type: SPEC lists direct|method without defining them; this corpus uses method for every callee of the form Type#m / recv.m / .m (including path calls Type::assoc()) and direct for free functions, module-path functions and named nested functions.
